name: /forge abort
summary: Use when user runs `/forge abort`, decides to abandon the current task, or needs to clear an active task slot before starting a new one.

name: /forge accept
summary: Use when /forge ship runs on a spec with acceptance_eval true, user runs /forge accept explicitly, or /forge ship --with-acceptance flag is provided.

name: /forge build
summary: Use when running `/forge build`, an approved plan exists, or the implementation phase of a standard or full tier task begins.

name: /forge build-light
summary: Use when user runs `/forge build` on a light-tier task, change touches 1 file and 20 lines or less, or has no spec or plan document.

name: /forge charter
summary: Create, update, check, and display the project charter (.forge/charter.md). Use when user runs /forge charter <sub>.

name: /forge control-cli
summary: Use when running /forge test --cli or when forge-test detects a CLI target.

name: /forge control-ui
summary: Use when running /forge test --ui or when forge-test detects a UI target with designer specs.

name: /forge debug
summary: Use when user says debug this, reports a regression, or after three consecutive build failures trigger the three-strike reroute.

name: /forge decide
summary: Use when starting a full-tier task, facing irreversible technical choices, or needing threat modeling before implementation.

name: /forge decide-teams
summary: Use when `/forge decide` is invoked and the topic involves architecture, security, cost, or product trade-offs requiring multiple viewpoints.

name: /forge fix
summary: Use when running /forge fix with bugfix.md + design.md + tasks.md workflow.

name: /forge fix-conflicts
summary: Use when git merge or rebase produces conflicts inside the forge config tree.

name: /forge forge-cmux-browser-qa
summary: Use when running /forge test with browser-based QA via cmux (requires cmux installed).

name: /forge forge-cmux-loop-signals
summary: Use when Forge Loop iterations are running and cmux sidebar signals are needed (requires cmux).

name: /forge forge-cmux-sidebar-sync
summary: Use when Forge lifecycle state changes and cmux sidebar needs syncing (requires cmux).

name: /forge grill
summary: Use when user starts full-tier task, says grill me, replies dig deeper during decide phase, or before locking an ambiguous spec.

name: /forge init
summary: Use when user runs `/forge init`, project has no .forge/ directory, or plugin is installed but project not yet initialized.

name: /forge learn
summary: Use when user runs `/forge learn`, task completes, or needs to convert session experience into persistent knowledge assets.

name: /forge loop
summary: Use when user runs /forge loop, wants unattended execution, or needs background completion of queued tasks.

name: /forge mutate
summary: Use when running `/forge mutate`, verifying test quality after a build, or checking mutation score against threshold.

name: /forge pack
summary: Use when running `/forge pack <subcommand>`, enabling a domain pack in a project, or creating a new pack skeleton.

name: /forge plan
summary: Use when running `/forge plan`, a spec is locked, or an actionable task breakdown is needed before build.

name: /forge recap
summary: Use when running /forge recap to review recent activity.

name: /forge refactor
summary: Use when running /forge refactor (DEPRECATED — use /forge build with work_nature=refactor instead).

name: /forge replay
summary: Use when running `/forge replay <topic>` to inspect the evidence chain for a task.

name: /forge resume
summary: Use when user runs `/forge resume`, a new session begins with prior work incomplete, or picking up interrupted work.

name: /forge review
summary: Use when running `/forge review`, build completes, or code changes need quality gate before ship.

name: /forge review-comment-bitbucket
summary: Use when posting /forge review findings to Bitbucket PR as tasks and inline comments.

name: /forge router
summary: Use when user runs `/forge <task>`, starts a new task, or needs skill dispatch across light, standard, or full workflow tiers.

name: /forge ship
summary: Use when running `/forge ship`, all review and test gates have passed, or a branch or pull request is ready to push.

name: /forge spec
summary: Use when user runs `/forge spec`, imports external PM spec, or building a new feature and lacks a locked spec.

name: /forge status
summary: Use when user runs `/forge status`, wants to see what tasks are in flight, or needs to know which phase a task currently sits in.

name: /forge storm
summary: Use when running `/forge storm <context>`, exploring a new Bounded Context, or building a domain model before writing specs.

name: /forge test
summary: Use when user runs `/forge test`, after build completes, or needs verification that behavior matches the locked spec.

name: /forge triage
summary: Use when user runs `/forge triage`, wants automated discovery of what to work on, or needs a periodic scan of Jira sprint / Bitbucket / git for actionable items. The 'discovery' action of loop engineering.

name: /forge verify
summary: Use when user runs `/forge verify <topic>` or during bugfix auto / debug Phase 4.

name: /forge zoom-out
summary: Use when user says zoom out, gets lost in details during skill execution, or runs `/forge zoom-out`.
